name: Kasuya Hitomi
source: Hitomi has been searching for her master and now that she’s found him, nothing shall barge in the way of their love. Inhuman reflexes, perfect hand-eye coordination, and on top of everything using chainsaw as her weapon, her combat abilities are levels beyond everyone else in the game.
translation: Hitomi has been searching for her master and now that she’s found him, nothing shall barge in the way of their love. Inhuman reflexes, perfect hand-eye coordination, and on top of everything using chainsaw as her weapon, her combat abilities are levels beyond everyone else in the game.
